title: Choose Àmì's visual world
question: This sets the look for the home page and every screen after it. Keep the lead direction, take an alternate, or re-roll for a fresh hand.

options.label: Proof of Payment
options.lineage: Nigerian transfer receipts and POS slips: the 'send proof of payment' culture
options.thesis: Every clip comes with its receipt: what you may do with it, for how long, and how much reaches the creator.
options.viewport: A big one-line promise and a search box over a full-width reel of playing clips; the first clip's licence receipt prints out beneath it with the price, the creator's 85% and a License button.
options.risk: Receipt detail can get busy. It only works if receipts appear at money moments and everything else stays bare white.

raised.raise: Four inks only: paper white, thermal black, receipt grey and one stamp violet. Hierarchy comes from size and inversion, never a fifth colour.
Type is ranked like a dance bill: one huge line per section, everything else small and quiet.
One pull does the work: tapping a clip prints its receipt, the single interaction that explains licensing.
Time is visible: every licence shows its days remaining, like a dated batch.

options.label: Selvedge
options.lineage: Wax-print and Ankara selvedges: the printed edge that proves the cloth is genuine
options.thesis: Àmì means 'mark'. Every clip carries a printed edge that proves it is the real one.
options.viewport: A white page bordered by one printed selvedge band; clips sit in a wide row, and a licensed clip's edge turns yellow with its licence number printed along it.
options.risk: Wax-print motifs are a familiar 'African design' shortcut, and pattern can crowd a page meant to feel calm.

options.label: Four-Shade Handheld
options.thesis: The catalogue as a tile-scrolling handheld game.
options.viewport: A pixel window of clips scrolled tile by tile.
options.case: Creators don't see themselves in it, and the green field breaks the white-page brief.
options.kept: Total palette discipline: four inks, no fifth.
options.risk: Reads as a novelty game, not a place to pay for licences.

options.label: Dance Bill
options.thesis: Creators billed by rank in outlined block caps.
options.viewport: Top creators stacked by size like a dance bill.
options.case: Fun ranking, but fluorescent card fights the calm white brief and buries prices.
options.risk: Loud by nature; the opposite of 'don't overwhelm'.

options.label: Drawcord Cape
options.thesis: One pull turns a flat plane into shape.
options.viewport: A black semicircle that gathers when pulled.
options.case: A luxury fashion object; says nothing about licences and isn't the creators' world.
options.kept: One control transforms the whole object.

options.label: Brine Calendar
options.viewport: A shelf of jars, each a licence with its day count.
options.case: Duration maps neatly, but the food costume confuses what is for sale.
options.kept: Time made visible as a state.

options.label: Live-Code Floor
options.thesis: The page as a live code buffer.
options.viewport: A code buffer that edits the catalogue live.
options.case: Wrong audience and wrong ground: black screens and code for skit makers.
options.kept: Show the change before it happens.

options.label: VU Meter Bridge
options.thesis: Trending clips as a row of needles.
options.viewport: A bridge of meters leaning with each clip's sales.
options.case: Reads as music production, not video licensing.
options.kept: Identical units repeated make the row its own ruler.
options.risk: Hardware nostalgia nobody here asked for.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean video marketplace in the Patreon and Netflix mould, done with care.
canonCard.viewport: A search-led headline, then rows of clips by category, then a short 'earn from your videos' band.
